caption: Every block is one 100 ms round trip. Non-persistent HTTP/1.0 pays a TCP handshake before each of the 4 objects (8 RTT = 800 ms), while HTTP/1.1 keeps one connection, skips the repeated handshakes and brings all three images back in a single round trip (3 RTT = 300 ms).

spec.aria: Timeline of one page load with 1 base file and 3 images at 100 ms per round trip: the HTTP/1.0 lane runs 8 blocks of 100 ms (4 TCP handshakes and 4 request-reply blocks) ending at 800 ms, and the HTTP/1.1 pipelined lane runs 3 blocks (one TCP handshake, the HTML, then all three images together) ending at 300 ms.
